## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for the change.

## Truth Surfaces

- [ ] Source and focused tests
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Packaged candidate, when affected
- [ ] Installed application, when affected
- [ ] Signed distribution evidence, when affected
- [ ] Physical platform evidence, when affected

## Verification

List the exact commands and results.

## Safety

- [ ] No database or user-data deletion
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, or personal data
- [ ] No unapproved deployment, publication, payment, or external communication
- [ ] Authentication and release paths fail closed when evidence is missing
- [ ] Optional feature boundaries remain independently removable
